title.narrative: • Replacement of dialysis machines, water purification and treatment plant, and air conditioning units at the dialysis center at Banadir Hospital in Mogadishu

description.narrative: Providing (25) kidney dialysis machines and (one) water purification and treatment plant according to the required specifications, providing (6) air conditioners according to the required specifications, in order to ensure the center’s continued operation with modern technologies and its continuous readiness.

Securing kidney dialysis machines, a water purification and treatment plant, and air conditioning units, and replacing the old ones, including supply, installation, operation, and training, with a guarantee, and including them in the center’s assets under the supervision of the center’s branch in Somalia, in order to ensure the kidney dialysis center’s continued readiness to provide its services.

The readiness of the dialysis center to continue providing its services and increase its capacity to accommodate (250) kidney failure patients and the staff of localizing the cadre (54) national cadres, and the beneficiaries of the project will become (304) direct beneficiaries.
